children.text: The editor’s light and dark. Designs keep their own themes.
What you act on: the main button, a switch on, the focus ring.
Shows 8px cells; what you place snaps to them.
Pins on the designs they’re left on.
The panels’ text. The canvas keeps its own zoom.
Darker muted text and firmer edges.
System follows your computer’s Reduce motion setting.
Theme is three cards with a drawing of the editor in each, as T3 Code’s, not a select: seen before it is picked.
Grid and Comments were only toggles on the canvas toolbar; they stay there and are listed here too.
Scroll wheel: a mouse user can make the wheel zoom, as Figma’s ‘Scroll to zoom’.
Text size of the interface; the canvas keeps its own zoom.
Increase contrast darkens muted text and edges (light’s muted text is chosen at 4.4:1); T3 Code has a contrast slider.
Motion: System, Reduced or Full; today the editor only follows the system.
